subject: POC week coordination: stakeholder roster, hands-on lab & load runbook
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@finlytics.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@finlytics.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-08T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff - week of March 22 availability + stakeholder list

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the run-through last week. The product looked promising and our engineering manager (Tom) is keen to get a hands-on POC running the week of March 22. To make the week productive we'd like a short kickoff (30m) to align goals and then 2 half-day lab sessions for prompt review, routing tests, and an initial load run.

Quick asks from our side:
- Can you confirm Redwood owners for the lab sessions and who will lead the load test?
- We’ll bring our ML infra lead and a backend engineer; I’ll share names once I confirm internal calendars.
- Success criteria: 1) prompt fidelity for our 50 test prompts, 2) sustained 50 rps for 5m with <250ms p99 on sample queries, 3) clear rollout plan for staging.

Do you have a draft agenda or runbook we can adapt? Also, my calendar is light on Mar 23–24 after 1pm PT.

Thanks,
Samira
Samira Khan
Head of Platform Partnerships
Finlytics

--
Note: attaching our baseline request profile (I’ll share as soon as Tom confirms)
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@finlytics.com>, Tom Ellis <t.ellis@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-09T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff - week of March 22 availability + stakeholder list

Hi Samira — great to hear, excited to run this with you. I’ve sketched an agenda and a lightweight load runbook; attaching POC_Agenda_v2.pdf and a sample load profile CSV. Marcus will own the load execution and we’ll have Monica run the prompt fidelity sessions. Dev will help with routing and KV cache alignment.

Proposed schedule (short):
- Mon Mar 22, 10:00–10:30 PT — Kickoff (stakeholders/roles/goal alignment) — (Irene, Samira, Tom, Lauren)
- Tue Mar 23, 09:00–13:00 PT — Hands-on Lab A (prompt review, chaining/routing experiments) — (Monica + Finlytics engs)
- Thu Mar 25, 09:00–13:00 PT — Load run & throughput validation (Marcus + Dev + Finlytics engs)

Can you confirm:
1) Tom and any others who should be on the kickoff invite?
2) Are the lab windows above workable for your team?
3) Any additional success metrics to add to the agenda?

I’ll hold tentative calendar invites and add a shared doc link for prompts.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0193

Thanks Irene — that schedule looks good. Confirming attendees from Finlytics: myself (eng mgr), Priya Rao (ML infra), and Aaron Cho (backend). All three are available for the slots you proposed; Tue morning is preferred for the prompt session.

A couple of clarifications:
- For the load run we’re targeting the same query mix we use in staging (I’ll send the exact CSV). Can Marcus validate whether Redwood needs any model warm-up steps or different KV cache settings ahead of the run?
- For success criteria, add a quality threshold: no more than 5% of prompts with hallucinations as defined in our shared doc.

Appreciate the fast turnaround. Tom

Subject: Re: POC kickoff - week of March 22 availability + stakeholder list

Tom — thanks for the details. Short answers:
- Warm-up: yes — we recommend a 5–10 minute warm-up of representative prompts at low concurrency (5–10 rps) to populate KV caches and JIT paths. I’ll include a warm-up snippet in the runbook.
- KV/cache config: we’ll provision a short-lived cache with the model instance for the duration of the test; no persistent changes needed.
- Hallucination metric: noted — Monica and I will instrument the eval harness to compute the % of hallucinations against your 50 prompt set.

I’ll be the run owner for Thu’s load window. Dev, can you confirm availability to help with routing tests on Thu morning?

—Marcus
Principal Performance Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Subject: Final invites: kickoff + lab + load run (week of March 22) — please RSVP

Hi all — thanks for confirming. I’ve sent calendar invites for the three sessions and attached the updated agenda + load profile. Key notes:
- Kickoff: Mon Mar 22, 10:00–10:30 PT (Google Meet link in calendar) — focus on roles, gating criteria, and test ownership.
- Lab A (prompt review): Tue Mar 23, 09:00–13:00 PT — Monica will lead prompt fidelity checks; please upload your 50 prompts to the shared doc by EOD Mon Mar 15.
- Load run: Thu Mar 25, 09:00–13:00 PT — Marcus (run owner) and Dev (routing/kv) will execute. Warm-up at 08:50.

Action items:
- Samira/Tom: share Finlytics’ final 50 prompts and the staging query mix (CSV) by Mar 15.
- Finlytics engs: confirm access to staging endpoints and add our test accounts to allow traffic.
- Internal: Monica to prepare the fidelity harness; Marcus/Dev to stage runbook and test infra by Mar 18.

If anyone needs to shift times, please reply with specific windows — we kept mid-week flexibility per your notes.

Thanks and looking forward to it — attaching POC_Agenda_v2.pdf and finlytics-load-profile.csv again for convenience.

Best,
Irene Choi
